input:
Scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和妈妈，within the same clause, do not repeat the same name inside a close possessive reference; use the shorter repeated reference.
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和他的妈妈，when the same person is mentioned again within one clause, use a pronoun rather than repeating the name.
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子和孟子妈妈：孟子和他的妈妈，孟子 has just been mentioned, so the pronoun rule calls for 他的妈妈 rather than repeating the name.

output.reason: All runs identify the redundant repetition in “孟子和孟子妈妈” and replace it with an acceptable shorter reference.
